ax_protocols.capabilities: Cryptographically signed Agent Card with RFC 8785 JCS canonicalisation and detached Ed25519 signature under `did:web:csoai.org` so external agents can verify identity before delegating measurement queries.

ax_protocols.authority_boundary: Never moves the page without `consent.watch === true`; stops at a visible Confirm before any `commit`, `pay`, or `schedule` step.

ax_protocols.authority_boundary: UI projection only; missing fields render as 'not in the payload' and a TIE stays a TIE.

claim_boundary: Measurement, not certification. AI models and AX/AG-UI/A2UI surfaces assist exploration, reproducible measurement, and proposal drafting; human approval via H.I.M. is required before signing or merging.

meok_him_action_loop.what_happens: End user or agent inspects any record across the SHA-pinned Busabase `gspc` export (`1,044` records), `23` GSPC axes, `6` non-model cohorts (`133` public rows), `417` frozen EU provisions, and `10` frozen SAFE records via Chat, MCP, A2A, AG-UI, or A2UI.

Runs or proposes a deterministic measurement (`verify_card`, `safe_pack_verify.py --offline`, Academy exercise, Arena bout, or `/request-attestation`) preserving `method`, `configuration`, `runtime`, `scope`, and a designed-to-fail negative control (`instrument_can_fail`).

Creates a bounded remediation or correction proposal (`autoMerge: false`, `effective_state: PROPOSED`) in Busabase `:15430` or `/api/corrections`. A correction is always a new dated record naming the superseded record by ID and SHA-256 while leaving replaced bytes readable.

H.I.M. escalates the verified measurement + negative-control receipt to a human reviewer. Only after explicit human approval is the record signed (`Ed25519` under `did:web:csoai.org`), witnessed (`RFC 9923`), and anchored (`OpenTimestamps` / `Rekor`).

records.statement: interceptor.py (sha256 d908b9e7...) returns VALID only for receipts whose key resolves to the named issuer, and never INVALID merely because resolution failed.
interceptor.py as served (sha256 b79ed7fe...) returns the expected VALID / INVALID / UNVERIFIABLE_KEY result for all 17 core cases.

records.procedure: python3 safe_export.py (jcs_probe()): 14 edge values + 2000 seeded doubles from 1e-8 to 1e22
records.statement: The reference canonicaliser writes every probed number and string exactly as RFC 8785 (ECMAScript) does.

records.procedure: python3 safe_export.py (jcs_probe()): 14 edge values + 2000 seeded doubles from 1e-8 to 1e22
records.statement: The reference canonicaliser writes every probed number and string exactly as RFC 8785 (ECMAScript) does.

records.procedure: Computed on this request, from these bytes. Strip unsigned_wrapper_fields from this document, canonicalise with json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True), SHA-256 it: that is recomputed_content_id and it must equal signature.attestation.content_id and signature.id. Then verify signature.signature as Ed25519 over the same canonical form of signature.attestation under key_ed25519_hex, which is the published key for did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1. Both must hold.
records.statement: The served ledger body hashes to the signed content_id, and that attestation verifies under the key in did.json.

records.procedure: read correction_latency {exact, upper_bound, unmeasured} from the signed ledger; recount per_entry
records.statement: Every ledger entry carries a first-hand detected_at and published_at, so its time-to-correct is measurable.

records.procedure: record.v0.1.2.signed.json: canonicalise payload (JSON, keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8); sha256 must equal signature.payload_sha256; payload.artifact.sha256 must equal sha256(record.v0.1.2.json); verify sig_ed25519 with #board-attestation-1 in https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json
records.statement: record.v0.1.2.json is signed by the board key and names v0.1.1 and v0.1 by sha256, and those bytes are still published.

records.procedure: Web search for the Australian Government's statement, any vendor statement and at least two independent reputable reports; each source fetched and its response hashed (response_sha256) on 2026-09-26; each date taken only from a quoted sentence; intervals are whole calendar days between dates (date(b) - date(a)); a month-only date yields a range, never a midpoint.
records.statement: The government's own transcript dates the run to 18 June 2026 and the first notification to 10 September 2026: 84 whole days.

records.procedure: for each batch: recompute every capsule_id and the batch Merkle root, check record sha256 and its board signature; then recompute index_root over the union of capsule ids; the index itself is signed (.signed.json) and OTS-stamped (.json.ots)
records.statement: The capsule index is signed by the board key and its digest matches the served bytes.

csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.ours: Dated ledger entries (78 as of 2026-09-28), each with what was wrong, how caught, what changed. Corrected records are new records that name the old by sha256; old bytes stay published (parity v0.1 -> v0.1.1 -> v0.1.2, AUTH INCONSISTENT 23 -> 10 -> 5).
csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: The RFC lets the affected party correct facts but says nothing about how a published finding is corrected, versioned or withdrawn.

csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.ours: Detached Ed25519 under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 with tamper controls; every signed record says a signature is not truth.
csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: No integrity, custody or signature requirement.

csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.ours: UNMEASURED carries null, never 0 or an estimate; PARTIAL never reported as a population total; NOT_DISCRIMINATING when a test has not shown it can fail; UNVERIFIABLE_KEY distinct from INVALID.
Every PASS/FAIL here carries a designed-to-fail control that failed; 44 of our own results were withdrawn when their grader could not fail.
csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.property: negative controls on the verification method
csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: Asks for a reproducible method, not one shown able to fail.

csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.ours: detected_at may be UNRECORDED; first-hand windows give upper bounds only; 72 of 78 ledger entries are UNMEASURED for time-to-correct rather than estimated.
csoai_extensions_not_in_rfc.rfc_gap: Clocks (ASAP, 72 h, 4 business days) assume detection and notification times exist.

frozen_to_fluid_saas_to_ras_pipeline.description: Enterprise or end-user record is SHA-256 pinned against the `417` frozen EU provisions, `23` GSPC axes (`axes-kb v3.1`), and `10` frozen OSAIA SAFE re-verification records.

Any change in a bound EU provision, GSPC axis bank, model/wrapper SHA-256 digest, or SAFE finding automatically transitions dependent training and attestation records from Frozen (`MEASURED`) to Fluid (`STALE`).
H.I.M. human reviewer approves the impacted list; MEOK drafts a consented Zernio message (`docs.zernio.com`, Nick-gated, zero unsolicited sends) or triggers a consented MEOK Voice / Agent HUD summon.
End user/enterprise enters the exact up-to-date Academy training module mapped to the changed regulation, GSPC axis, or OSAIA SAFE finding.

User executes the reproducible exercise (`council-os/academy/module-inventory.json`); exam passes only when `state == 'REPRODUCED'` (local SHA-256 matches published SHA-256 AND the negative control fails as designed).
User completes the gamified Human-vs-AI Arena / Council City Red-vs-Blue simulation challenge and receives a `<= 3KB` Water/Milk/Honey MOOC completion receipt.
frozen_to_fluid_saas_to_ras_pipeline.service_tier: Gamified Human-vs-AI Arena (`4,760` Rounds) & Council City (`40v40`) MOOC

frozen_to_fluid_saas_to_ras_pipeline.description: With H.I.M. human-in-the-loop sign-off (`Ed25519` + `RFC 9923` witness), a new content-addressed RAS record is issued (`supersedes: <prior_sha256>`), returning the enterprise from Fluid (`STALE`) back to Frozen (`MEASURED`).

stages.description: A change event in a regulatory provision (`417` frozen provisions), a GSPC axis bank (`axes-kb v3.1`), a model/wrapper SHA-256 digest, or a SAFE finding (`DIVERGENT`/`FAIL`) is recorded with `inception_*` lineage.
stages.title: Regulation, Axis Bank, Model Digest, or SAFE Finding Change Event

stages.description: Affected training completions or measurement attestation records transition from `MEASURED` to `STALE` (projected as `needs_reconciliation` in the 6-state MEOK Agent HUD). Prior signed bytes remain immutable.
stages.title: Dependent Training & Attestation Records Marked `STALE`

stages.description: H.I.M. compiles the impact list for human approval; outreach is generated strictly as opt-in consented drafts (zero unsolicited sends; outbound messaging stays Nick-gated).
stages.title: H.I.M.-Approved Impact List & Opt-In Consented Notification Drafts

stages.description: Operator/reviewer runs the updated Academy reproducible exercise (`state: REPRODUCED` + negative control) and executes a comparable re-measurement on the affected GSPC axis.
stages.title: Academy HITL Refresher, Reproducible Exercise & Comparable Retest

stages.description: Issues a new human-signed, content-addressed measurement record (`supersedes: <prior_sha256>`) via the RAS / `x402` evidence rail (`measurement, never certification`).
stages.title: Re-Attest as Request-as-a-Service (RAS) with Explicit Supersession

Never sends unsolicited messages; stays Nick-gated until Zernio credentials are configured.
